referral.title: Refer a friend
referral.description: Share your code. When a friend signs up and enters it, your friend gets 7 days and you get 3 days, saved for your next Premium plan. You can earn from up to 5 friends.

rewards.title: Rate and review NewsVocab
rewards.description: Write a rating and review, then press "I have done it" and type the name shown on your review. After a quick check 3 days are added to your plan.

proof.label: The name shown on your review (and its date)

rewards.title: Share NewsVocab on Instagram
rewards.description: Post or share it on Instagram, then press "I have done it" and paste the link of your post. After a quick check 7 days are saved and added to your next Premium plan.

proof.label: Link to your Instagram post or reel
